newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ May up 5.00 cent limit on technicals, strike.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ May up 5.00 cent limit on technicals, strike.

text.p: NEW YORK, March 4 (Reuter) Frozen concentrated orange juice May futures climbed the daily 5.00-cent limit higher to 86.80 cents a lb in late trade on technically driven buying and fears that a strike in Brazil cut limit supplies, market sources said.
At 1405 EST, the contract remained was 5.10 cents higher to 86.90 cents while the deferred contracts were trading 4.90 to 1.85 cents firmer.
"This is technical in nature but also psychological because people are talking about the strike in Brazil," Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter, said.

Dockworkers at Brazil's Paranagua port have threatened to stage a 24-hour strike Wednesday. Georgakis said the strike is not likely to hurt orange juice exports since the industry relies more heavily on the private sector for its exports, however.
She added that a jump above the 18-day moving average of 82.57 cents in May sparked new buying by the speculators and the funds in early trade.
